english.note: Use 教 as the all-purpose verb for passing on knowledge, including a threatening 教你... meaning “I’ll teach you a lesson.”
Use this as the all-purpose spoken verb for teaching or coaching someone.
This is the all-purpose choice for instructing or teaching someone in everyday Cantonese.
Use 教 when teaching someone how to do something by explaining or showing the steps.
Use 教 for the teaching or educating aspect of training someone, rather than the conditioning aspect.

examples.english: I’ll teach you how to cook this dish.
examples.jyutping: ngo5 gaau3 nei5 dim2 joeng2 zyu2 ni1 mei6 sung3
ngo5 gaau3 nei5 daa2 jyu5 mou4 kau4

examples.english: I’ll educate you on how to use this machine.
examples.jyutping: ngo5 gaau3 nei5 dim2 joeng2 jung6 ni1 bou6 gei1

examples.english: I instruct you how to use this coffee machine.
examples.traditional: 我教你點樣用呢部咖啡機。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 gaau3 nei5 dim2 joeng2 jung6 ni1 bou6 gaa3 fe1 gei1

examples.english: I train my son to play soccer.
examples.jyutping: ngo5 gaau3 go3 zai2 tek3 bo1
